Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions-and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare-and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

About the Role

We're looking for a Trust & Integrity Manager to lead the function that protects the integrity of the patient experience and the Solace platform. Sitting within the Customer Experience team, you'll build and manage the team responsible for identifying, investigating, and resolving situations that pose risk to patients, advocates, or Solace's operations.

This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, advocate accountability, and operational risk. You'll own the strategy and standards for case review, oversee a team handling escalations and investigations, monitor for emerging patterns at a portfolio level, and ensure advocates are operating within Solace's protocols and standards. Reporting to CX leadership, you'll work closely with QA, operations, CX, and senior internal stakeholders to build a trustworthy, safe, and high-quality experience for every patient we serve and to scale that trust as Solace grows.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

- Coach and manage a team of Trust & Integrity Specialists, setting clear expectations and learning paths

- Establish and refine workflows, SLAs, and quality standards for complaint handling, investigations, and advocate oversight

- Conduct case reviews and calibration sessions to ensure consistency and rigor across the team

- Build a culture of empathy, precision, and accountability within the team

Patient Safety & Complaint Management

- Own escalation paths for the most complex or high-severity patient safety concerns and adverse experience reports

- Ensure the team investigates and resolves complaints in a timely, thorough, and empathetic manner, with clear documentation standards

- Define criteria for urgent intervention and coordinate cross-functional response for the highest-risk situations

- Serve as final escalation point for patients or stakeholders when a case requires manager-level judgment

Advocate Oversight & SOP Compliance

- Uphold the process by which advocate behavior, conduct, and quality concerns are reviewed

- Partner with QA and team leads to adjudicate cases requiring formal performance review or corrective action

- Own the integrity and confidentiality of investigation records and reporting

- Drive continuous improvement of SOPs and ethical guidelines based on case learnings

Risk Strategy & Pattern Analysis

- Build and own risk monitoring practices across patient feedback, escalation data, and operational signals

- Identify systemic risk patterns and lead root-cause analysis, translating findings into concrete mitigations

- Own the risk reporting cadence to CX and cross-functional leade

title: Accounts Payable Analyst
company: JC Davis Ventures LLC dba JC Davis Power
description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. Powering a jobsite shouldn't be a hassle. But too often, crews are left waiting, equipment breaks down, vendors go dark, and deadlines slip.
We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We're a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and tower lighting. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.
We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.
Simple - Reliable - Done Right!
The Role
Every job site we support depends on equipment, fuel, parts, and subcontractors; each tied to an invoice that must be accurate.. As our Accounts Payable Analyst, you will manage the full payables cycle from invoice intake and three-way matching to payment runs, vendor reconciliations, and month-end close.
This is more than processing. You will be the person who spots the coding error before it distorts job costs, who reconciles the vendor statement nobody else wants to touch, and who tells us what our spend is doing. As the business grows, you will help build the payables process that scales with it.
What You'll Do

• Process the payables volume. Review, code, and enter high volumes of vendor invoices, matching to purchase orders and receiving documentation and resolving discrepancies before they hit the ledger.

• Own job and GL coding accuracy. Code invoices to the correct general ledger accounts, jobs, and cost categories so project profitability and equipment costs stay clean.

• Run payments. Prepare and process check, ACH, and card payment runs on schedule, applying payment terms, discounts, and approval requirements.

• Reconcile vendor accounts. Reconcile vendor statements, research aged and unmatched items, and work directly with vendors to resolve disputes, credits, and short pays.

• Support month-end close. Prepare AP accruals, reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, and clear open items so close is not held up by payables.

• Report on payables and spend. Build and maintain aging, cash requirement, and vendor spend reporting, and flag trends and exceptions to the Manager, Accounts Payable and Accounting leadership.

• Improve the process. Identify the bottlenecks and recurring errors in the payables cycle, propose fixes, and help implement automation and workflow improvements in our systems.

• Keep vendor data and compliance clean. Maintain vendor master records, collect and verify W-9s, support 1099 preparation, and apply sales and use tax treatment correctly.

• Support audits and internal controls. Pull documentation and provide support for internal reviews and external audit requests, and follow approval and segregation of duties requirements.

• Partner with the field and operations. Work with managers, purchasing, and shop teams to chase down missing approvals, packing slips, and PO detail to ensure invoices are processed without delay

• Reconciling credit card accounts. Manage end-to-end reconciliation for high-volume corporate credit card accounts (50+ cards / $100K+ monthly volume), ensuring all transactions are matched with valid receipts, properly coded, and cleared against the general ledger. Investigate and resolve credit card transaction discrepancies, disputed charges, and unapplied credits with vendors and card-issuing banks.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of accounts payable experience, including full cycle, high volume processing

• Hands on experience with purchase order based invoicing and three-way match

• Experience reconciling vendor statements and the AP subledger to the general ledger

• Working knowledge of an ERP or accounting

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Who We Are Looking For

The Media Activation team is responsible for providing thoughtful, high-impact recommendations across digital channels, maintaining platform partnerships, and executing media buys with precision.

We are seeking an experienced Director, Activation to lead digital activation across key client business. In this role, you will lead the channel activation strategy with a primary emphasis on Paid Social and a foundational focus on Programmatic, ensuring flawless operational execution and strong cross-functional alignment.

The ideal candidate brings extensive digital media expertise, a structured approach to workflow management, and proven experience managing media teams, client relationships, and inter-departmental collaboration.

What You’ll Do

• Activation Leadership: Direct the end-to-end strategy, setup, and optimization of Paid Social (core focus) and Programmatic campaigns, driving performance against lower-funnel KPIs including app acquisition and conversions.

• Team Management & Resourcing: Lead and mentor a team consisting of a Social Manager and a Programmatic Manager, while coordinating deliverables with global offshore support teams. Actively manage team capacity, timelines, and resource allocation.

• Operational Process & Structure: Establish robust QA processes, pacing protocols, and standardized operational workflows to ensure consistency and execution excellence.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Planning and Performance leads to align on strategic briefs, balance deliverables, and maintain clear operational boundaries across departments.

• Client Stewardship: Serve as the senior activation lead in client interactions, translating complex technical campaign data into strategic insights and managing expectations effectively.

• Platform Innovation: Evaluate and pilot emerging digital ad platforms and formats (including conversational AI and new discovery ad channels) as client media plans evolve.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: 6+ years of digital media activation experience within an agency or brand environment, including proven experience managing direct reports.

• Paid Social Acumen: Advanced expertise in Paid Social platforms and performance strategies; hands-on experience with mobile app performance and conversion-driven campaigns is an asset.

• Programmatic Working Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of programmatic buying, DSP mechanics, and data targeting strategies.

• Resource & Scope Management: Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, balance bandwidth, and negotiate timelines with cross-functional partners and external stakeholders.

• Organizational Skills: Proven track record of managing multi-channel workflows and implementing structured processes in fast-paced environments.

• Stakeholder Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate media rationale clearly to both technical teams and senior clients.

• Channel Agility: Willingness to adapt to and test emerging media formats; traditional paid search experience is not required.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Me

title: Loans Manager for FLDG
description:
Company description
Netbank is a start-up fintech led bank, focused on the under-served. Its model is to:

• Partner with Fintechs, banks and non-bank lenders, who have existing client networks or are looking to enter the Philippines

• Allow these partners to sign-up clients, for an origination fee, booked on Netbank s balance sheet. Netbank would provide:

• Loans to clients, so the partners can grow without raising additional capital

• Deposit accounts for clients, serviced by the partner (on a white-label basis)

• Payment services to clients, including ACH payments, access to cards, payment to wallets, etc.

• Technology services to the partners, allowing them more efficient processing and better client satisfaction

Netbank Virtual is a product area of Netbank , offering banking as a service via APIs to local fintech and international fintech looking to enter the market. It expects to offer services in:

• Disburse funds: Payments via ACH, payments to wallets, payments to cash.

• Collect funds: Receive funds from the above channels

• Open transaction accounts / wallets

• Open loan accounts.

Netbank will offer segment specific solutions, aiming to roll-out products to a pilot client and then a range of similar clients.
Responsibilities:
This position is a member of the team responsible for services to lenders.
The FLDG Loans Manager is responsible for product and business development for cash loans, mostly under FLDG.
The steps in product development will be:

• Definition of product design to understand the data that can be gathered from the platform / payroll provider

• Understanding of the repayment process to ensure these loans are self-liquidating

• Assessment of size of loan partner, growth opportunity

• Identification of additional data that may be available on the end client

• Definition of data sources that can be used to assess creditworthiness.

• Creation of legal agreements / specific processes to reduce credit risk

• Definition of process design (document sharing, etc.)

• Legal and contractual work with the platform / with the borrower

• Product definition (term, tenor, etc.)

The steps in partner development will be:

• Understand the product that Netbank can provide to end clients.

• Listen carefully to the situation of these lenders and align our sales strategy to their situation

• Describe the solution and work with the partners as they develop the solution. Explain the regulation, the options, the financial implications.

• Provide advisory services to potential partners, to accelerate the on-boarding process and prove our culture of relentless implementation

• Commercial negotiation

• Support clients through implementation. Work closely with the clients to on-board them.

The steps in partner optimisation will be:

• Identify product enhancements which ensure we meet the full needs of our end clients around lending products.

• Identify causes of losses and ways to reduce these losses through credit risk mitigations

• Identify additional products to sell to the end clients, such as additional loans, accounts, insurance, etc.

• Identify how we can support internal processes of partners, such as by implementing collection accounts, etc.

As with all solutions providers, the position holder will need to:

• Deeply understand client needs for the proposed services and identify ways that Netbank can provide a product significantly better than the competition

• Implement the product to achieve this differentiation, including ensuring the technical system capabilities can meet client requirement

• Managing a highly professional sales and on-boarding process, which responds at the speed that Fintech demand, keeps partners fully informed through the implementation process.

• Identify additional services which clients need and propose these to clients. Identify product gaps and identify technical partnerships and technology solutions that allow us to offer these services.

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

Overview
At PrizePicks , we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth from real-time contest engines to the services that handle millions of daily transactions. We are looking for a talented and driven Senior Software Engineer to join our Back Office team and help us build the internal platform that powers every operation at PrizePicks .
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer fluent in both Ruby on Rails and Go to join our Back Office team. Back Office is the internal operational platform used by Game Ops, Trading, Member Operations, and Risk teams to configure projections, trade lines, manage members, review risk, and monitor live scoring - all of which directly shapes what millions of members see in the app.
In this role, you will design and build backend services that span our Rails monolith and our growing ecosystem of Rails and Go microservices. You will work across existing as well as new services being carved out as we migrate toward a microservices architecture. You will tackle high-scope, complex technical problems, own features end-to-end, and mentor engineers on your team. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable extending a mature Rails codebase and greenfielding a new Go service, and who is energized by the challenge of a platform in active, deliberate evolution.
What You'll Do

•
Build and own backend services : Design and implement features across both Rails-based services and Go microservices - from API contracts through deployment and monitoring.

•
Support the migration to microservices : Help decompose the Rails monolith into well-scoped, independently deployable services, contributing to architectural decisions about what to extract and how.

•
Power internal tooling APIs : Build and maintain the backend APIs that Back Office operators depend on for real-time decisioning - projection management, risk dashboards, alerting, and member operations.

•
Own technical delivery : Lead the design and implementation of complex features end-to-end, from product requirements through production deployment.

•
Drive system reliability : Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries, and improve resilience of backend systems under load.

•
Define technical direction : Propose and drive architectural decisions for your team's services, evaluating tradeoffs and communicating recommendations clearly to engineers and stakeholders.

•
Mentor and elevate : Provide hands-on mentorship to Software Engineers I, II, and III through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

•
Improve engineering practices : Advocate for and improve best practices around code quality, testing, observability, and deployment for the team.

•
Collaborate cross-functionally : Work closely with Product Managers, QA, and other engineering teams to translate operational goals into well-scoped technical solutions.

•
Participate in on-call rotation : Share responsibility for production incidents, contributing to root cause analysis and long-term reliability improvements.

What You Have
Experience:

• 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful production time in both Ruby on Rails and Go

• Proven track record of owning and delivering complex, multi-component features in a team environm

title: Research Engineer, Intern – Benchmarking
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer at Mercor, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering and applied AI research. You’ll own benchmarking pipelines, evaluation systems, and failure analysis workflows that directly inform how we train and improve frontier language models.
Your work will define how we measure tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning. You’ll design and run evals, build rubrics and scorers, and turn failure analysis into actionable improvements for post-training, RLVR, and data pipelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Benchmarking: Design, implement, and maintain benchmarks and metrics for tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning; ensure benchmarks scale with training and stay aligned with product and research goals.

- Evaluation systems: Build and operate LLM evaluation systems end-to-end runs, scoring, dashboards, and reporting, so researchers and applied AI teams can track model performance and compare runs at scale.

- Failure analysis: Run systematic failure analysis on model outputs (e.g., wrong tool use, reasoning errors, safety/alignment issues); categorize failure modes, quantify prevalence, and feed findings into reward design, data curation, and benchmark design.

- Rubrics and evaluators: Create and refine rubrics, automated evaluators, and scoring frameworks that drive training and evaluation decisions; balance rigor with scalability (human vs. model-as-judge, calibration, agreement).

- Data quality and usability: Quantify data usability, quality, and impact on key benchmarks; use evals and failure analysis to guide data generation, augmentation, and curation.

- Cross-team collaboration: Work with AI researchers, applied AI teams, and data producers to align evals with training objectives and to prioritize benchmarks and failure analyses that matter most.

- Ownership in a fast-paced environment: Operate in a high-iteration research setting with strong ownership of benchmarks, evals, and failure-analysis workflows.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong applied research background, with focus on model evaluation, benchmarking, and/or failure analysis.

- Strong coding skills and hands-on experience with ML models and evaluation code.

- Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and backend systems.

- Comfort with APIs, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud platforms for running and storing eval results.

- Ability to reason about model behavior, experimental results, and data quality from evals and failure analyses.

- Excitement to work in person in San Francisco five days a week in a high-intensity, high-ownership environment.

NICE TO HAVE

- Industry experience on a post-training or evaluation/benchmarking team (highest priority).

- Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL), especially in evaluation or benchmarking.

- Experience building or running LLM evaluations, benchmarks, or failure-analysis pipelines.

- Experience with synthetic data generation, rubric design, or RL-style workflows th

Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.

What you'll do

- Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines

- Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide

- Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation

- Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

- Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue

You may be a fit if

- You have 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition

• Participate in planning and estimation, maintain the architecture backlog and make trade-offs across cost, risk, quality, security and time-to-market.

• Coordinate with other architects, security, platform and engineering teams to align designs with enterprise standards and delivery constraints.

• Strong architecture experience across cloud-native application, integration, data and security domains, with the judgement to balance governance and delivery pace.

title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk
description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk

 

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

About the Role

9 Mothers builds hardware in Austin, TX, and this role is the single point of contact for everything that comes into or leaves our building. You own receiving end to end: every package, every packing list, every handoff to the person waiting on it. No prior experience is required. What matters most is that you are reliable and detail-oriented, because a shipment that is misplaced or logged wrong stalls the people who need it.

 

What You'll Do

- Receive every delivery to the building and check it against its packing list

- Log each shipment in our receiving system and keep packing lists filed and traceable

- Organize incoming packages so anything can be found quickly

- Notify recipients when their items arrive and hand them off

- For outbound shipments, package and label the item, drive it to the carrier, and confirm it has gone out

- Keep the receiving area clean and orderly

What We're Looking For

- Reliable: you are here every day, on time, and no delivery goes uncaught

- Detail-oriented: you check quantities and part numbers against the packing list and don't let a discrepancy slide

- Organized, with basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, or an inventory/receiving system)

- Valid driver's license and a clean driving record

- Able to lift and move packages up to 50 lb

- Prior receiving, shipping, warehouse, or inventory experience is a plus but not required

Hours & Location

- Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., onsite in Austin, TX

- The hours are fixed so someone is always on hand for every delivery window

 

Benefits

- Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

- Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

- Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

- The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

- 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

- Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

- Zero Red Tape: You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

- Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

- Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.

 

About the Interview

1. Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call)

2. Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams)

3. Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in-person)

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.
About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. Reporting to Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.
OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.
Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.
This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.
We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.
This is a fully remote role for people based in the United States, working within one hour of US Eastern Time.
Responsibilities

•
Own delivery end to end for OpenMined 's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates.

•
Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change.

•
Build AI into how we manage projects : use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep.

•
Make the whole team better at project management : set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires.

•
Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift.

•
Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute re

title: Projectvoorbereider Treinbeveiliging
description:
Jouw Ambitie
Wil jij méér verantwoordelijkheid in treinbeveiliging? Als projectvoorbereider zorg jij dat complexe railprojecten strak voorbereid het spoor op gaan. Grotere projecten, meer invloed, volgende stap.
Dit wordt jouw baan
Voor een projectvoorbereider bij Dura Vermeer Railinfra is geen dag hetzelfde. Het accent van jouw takenpakket zal met name liggen in het organiseren en beheersen van de processen die ervoor zorgen dat de monteurs optimaal hun werk kunnen doen. Binnen jouw functie als projectvoorbereider schep je de voorwaarden voor een optimale uitvoering. Zonder jou kunnen de mensen buiten hun werk niet goed uitvoeren.
Projecten waar je bij Dura Vermeer aan kan denken? Bijvoorbeeld het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoor (PHS) project Nijmegen een totale metamorfose van het stationsgebied of de uitbreiding van het emplacement Maasvlakte West van 18 naar 36 sporen. Een grote diversiteit aan projecten. Wij zoeken samen met jou naar een project dat bij je past. Je switcht makkelijk tussen taken, thema’s, bouwvergaderingen en leveranciersgesprekken. Binnen het project ben je de spil tussen ontwerp, uitvoering en commercie. Je ondersteunt zowel op technisch en administratief als op organisatorisch vlak. Verder verzorg je de inkoop en selectie van onderaannemers en stel je de overeenkomsten op. Jij vindt het geen probleem om ongeveer één keer per maand in het weekend op het spoor aanwezig te zijn tijdens een buitendienststelling.
Ook heb jij genoeg technische kennis om alle vragen te kunnen beantwoorden en ben je een daarin een stevige sparringspartner. Je komt te werken in een divers team, waar successen samen gevierd worden. In je werk heb je veel verantwoordelijkheid, maar ook enorm veel vrijheid!
Als verantwoordelijke voor de technische voorbereiding van de treinbeveiliging/seinwezen deelprojecten in een railproject, ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bepalen van benodigdheden, personeel, werkplannen en planningen. Je werkt samen met de uitvoering om werkmethoden af te stemmen en zorgt voor afstemming met onderaannemers. Je bewaakt de technische randvoorwaarden en rapporteert over kwaliteit, veiligheid, arbeidsomstandigheden en milieu. Je zorgt ook voor afstemming tussen verschillende techniekvelden. Jouw doel is om het project binnen de tijd en efficiënt te laten verlopen.
Requirements
Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent - iconisch én dichtbij - en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.
Dit breng jij mee

• Je hebt een minimaal afgeronde mbo opleiding in een technische richting, zoals elektrotechniek;

• Je hebt een aantal jaren werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie als werkvoorbereider of technisch coördinator bij voorkeur binnen de railsector;

• Je beschikt over kennis van arbeids-, milieu- en veiligheidsregelgeving, en over algemene kennis van treinbeveiligingstechniek;

• Je hebt ervaring in het lezen van rail verkeerstechnische ontwerpen (RVTO)

• Je wordt enthousiast van het werken door heel Nederland en je bent bereid om ook in de weekenden, avonden en nachten aanwezig te zijn om je collega’s te helpen waar nodig.;

• Je bent sterk in plannen en orga

title: Solutions Lead, Clinical & EHR Systems
description:
OUR VISION

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10-20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $32M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

 

OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story. Interview with us to hear them!

- 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

- 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

- 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort - we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

- 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it - no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 

ABOUT VITALIZE'S ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS TEAM

Our customers operate complex technology environments spanning workforce management, HR, payroll, EHRs, identity, security, and other enterprise systems. As Vitalize takes on larger health systems and expands what our platform can do, the technical complexity of selling, deploying, and supporting our product grows with it.

Enterprise Solutions exists to make that complexity scalable. The function bridges Growth and Post-Sales - ensuring we understand what's technically possible before we sell it, customers are technically ready to go live, and the hardest problems we encounter become repeatable solutions the broader team can own. Done well, Enterprise Solutions helps us activate revenue faster, make deployments more predictable, and scale to increasingly complex customers without scaling technical support linearly.

THE ROLE

You’ll be one of the first two Enterprise Solutions hires at Vitalize, building the function from scratch alongside a peer focused on workforce and payroll systems. Together you’ll define what Enterprise Solutions becomes as our customer base and Post-Sales organization grow.

title: Sr. Denials Prevention Analyst
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America) This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Senior Denials Prevention Analyst is an operational subject‑matter expert in denial prevention who combines advanced revenue cycle analytics with targeted account sampling to identify trends, pinpoint root causes, and drive sustainable reductions in initial denials for maximum reimbursement. The role prepares denial prevention materials that synthesize denial metrics, initiative status, and workgroup findings; leads cross‑functional discussions to connect interdependent topics; and supports DPTF Workgroups by documenting minutes, key takeaways, action items, owners, and due dates, and coordinating follow‑ups. The analyst monitors denial prevention KPIs and initiative progress, quantifies net revenue opportunities and realized benefits, and maintains benefit‑tracking dashboards and concise leadership readouts. Partnering closely with revenue cycle and, as appropriate, clinical operations and IT/Epic teams, the role translates insights into actionable prevention plans, monitors and helps implement workflow and system improvements, and tracks adoption, outcomes, and barriers. The Senior Denials Prevention Analyst leverages strong problem‑solving, data visualization, and knowledge of reimbursement policies and healthcare operations to deliver durable results.

Locations
Stanford Health Care
What you will do

• Perform revenue cycle denial analytics to trend issues, identify root causes, and prioritize denial prevention opportunities.

• Conduct targeted account sampling and case reviews to validate findings and help define corrective actions.

• Prepare concise analytics summaries, denial prevention related PowerPoints and reports, and leadership readouts of workgroup findings.

• Lead and facilitate cross-functional discussions; connect interdependent topics across workgroups to align solutions.

• Build and maintain action plans with clear owners, timelines, and success metrics; document minutes, key takeaways, and next steps; distribute follow-up communications, reports, and analytics to attendees.

• Monitor denial prevention KPIs, initiative progress, and associated revenue impact; explain fluctuations and escalate barriers.

• Lead cross-functional root cause analysis with Patient Access, Patient Financial Clearance, UM/CM, CDI, HIM/Coding, Clinical Operations, and PFS to identify workflow, system, policy, and education changes needed to prevent denials and monitor progress on implementation of remediation strategies.

• Help develop and implement denial prevention strategies, workflows, and playbooks and monitor their effectiveness through regular KPI reporting.

• Monitor payer policy changes, national guidelines, and CMS/Medicare/Medicaid updates to ensure compliance and timely adjustment of practices.

• Maintain denial dashboards, action plans, and performance reports for leadership review.

• Prepare denial reports and summary findings of analysis for department leadership; maintain clear documentation of analyses and outcomes; escalate systemic risks and barriers as appropriate.

Education Qualifications

• High school diploma (or GED equivalent). Required

• Bachelor’s degree in a work-related field/discipline from an accredited college or university. Preferred

Experience Qualifications

• Five (5) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience, with a preference for denial prevention, denial management, prior authorization, or revenue cycle specific experience.

• Two (2) years’ experience in denial prevention, denial recovery, prior auth, registration, coding, or denial management related role within a healthcare setting.

• 1-2 years of statistical analysis experience.

Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection . We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.
Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.
We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry .
💼 About the Role
Murphy is building the AI agents that will run real collections conversations for banks, lenders and collection agencies across Chile - and we need people who've actually done the job to make sure our AI does it right. We're recruiting Debt-Collection Experts to join our advisor network in a consultant/advisor capacity : no full-time commitment, just your judgment and experience, paid by the hour (roughly 5-20 hours per month ).
You'll work directly with Murphy's product and AI teams to pressure-test how our voice agents negotiate, escalate, and stay compliant - bringing the floor-level and strategic reality of Chile collections into how we design and train our technology.

Domain Review & AI Validation

• Review call flows, scripts and negotiation logic used by Murphy's AI agents and flag anything that doesn't match how a real collections desk would handle it.

• Validate cadence, cure-rate assumptions, settlement/negotiation ranges, and escalation paths against real-world practice.

• Stress-test edge cases: disputes, renegotiation, hardship, repeat promises-to-pay, and regulatory triggers.

Compliance & Local Nuance

• Flag anything that could create compliance risk under Chile consumer-protection rules.

• Advise on tone, channel mix and contact-frequency norms considered acceptable vs. abusive in the Chiliean market.

Knowledge Transfer

• Join periodic working sessions (calls/async review) with Murphy's product and engineering teams.

• Share real examples, scripts and playbooks from your own collections experience (anonymized, no client data).

🎯 What We're Looking For

• Bank in-house collections leaders - you've owned the creditor-side process: placement strategy, make-vs-buy decisions, and portfolio oversight.

• DCA / servicer / BPO collections & contact-centre managers - you've run the floor: cadence, scripts, cure rates, and agent incentives.

And you likely also have:

• 5+ years of experience in collections.

• Current or recent (≤2 years) experience at a named bank, DCA, servicer or BPO.

• A title of Manager, Team Lead, Head, Director or VP (front-line agent/officer/advisor titles only qualify if you've since moved into managing a team).

• English Native speaker.

⏱️ The Engagement

• Format: consultant/advisor, paid hourly.

• Time commitment: approx. 5-20 hours/month , flexible around your schedule.

• Fully remote.

🚀 Why Join

• Shape how AI actually collects debt at some of the world's top banks

• Flexible, low-commitment engagement that fits around your current job.

• Work directly with a founding product/AI team backed by Northzone, ElevenLabs and Lakestar.

• Competitive hourly consulting fee.

- Define the CAN/J1939 network architecture, message databases, fault handling and state machines across BMS, PDU, converters, charger and the system management computer.

- Lead supplier engagement: RFI/RFQ, technical evaluation, source selection, and management of suppliers from prototype samples through production.

- Collaborate with mechanical engineering on thermal management and packaging, with electrical engineering on interfaces to powered subsystems, and with software/firmware on controls and diagnostics.

- Produce and maintain design documentation: block diagrams, ICDs, schematics, harness drawings, requirement compliance matrices and design review packages.

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field (power electronics, energy systems)

- At least 5 years of hands-on experience designing and integrating high-voltage (400-800 V) battery and power systems for EVs, commercial/off-highway vehicles, energy storage or defense platforms.

- Direct experience with battery pack and BMS integration, HV distribution (contactors, precharge, fusing, IMD) and HV saf

title: Gestionnaire de l'ingénierie, Grand livre auxiliaire// Engineering Manager, Subledger
description:
À propos du poste

À titre de gestionnaire de l'ingénierie pour l'équipe du grand livre auxiliaire, vous serez responsable du système de référence pour chaque transaction financière chez Hopper, assurant l'exactitude des rapports et le rapprochement de tous les mouvements de fonds dans notre écosystème.

Chaque équipe qui traite des transactions, tant pour la réservation que pour l'après-réservation, dépend du grand livre auxiliaire; vous façonnerez donc l'architecture de la plateforme financière d'Hopper aux côtés des équipes Finances, Comptabilité, Paiements et des équipes d'ingénierie produit qui s'y appuient. Vous serez la personne responsable principale sur le plan technique d'un système où l'exactitude et la traçabilité complète comptent plus que tout, conciliant la rigueur comptable et le jugement technique nécessaire à son évolution.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

- Assumer la responsabilité et la gestion de la plateforme de grand livre auxiliaire avec une approche axée sur les résultats, en agissant comme point de contact principal pour les sujets techniques, comptables et opérationnels liés à l'enregistrement et au rapprochement des transactions

- Diriger, faire grandir et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieur(e)s, en définissant l'orientation technique et en prônant l'exactitude dans un système où chaque écriture doit balancer

- Piloter l'architecture du grand livre auxiliaire, en faisant évoluer la conception actuelle vers la simplicité et l'évolutivité grâce à des abstractions solides et à l'automatisation

- Veiller à ce que tous les mouvements de fonds, tant à la réservation qu'après la réservation, soient comptabilisés avec exactitude, avec une traçabilité complète de l'événement source jusqu'au rapport financier

- Établir des relations solides de haut niveau avec les équipes Finances et Comptabilité, en traduisant les exigences comptables en conception de système et en signalant tôt les contraintes techniques

- Collaborer avec les équipes Paiements, Réservations, Après-réservation et Données qui s'intègrent au grand livre auxiliaire, en vous alignant sur les contrats, les modèles de données et les parcours de migration

- Repérer et saisir les occasions de réduire l'effort de rapprochement manuel, de combler les lacunes de production de rapports et d'éliminer des catégories entières d'écarts à la source

- Suivre des indicateurs clés comme l'exactitude des rapprochements, le taux de transactions non appariées, les délais du cycle de clôture et la fiabilité du système, et diriger des revues récurrentes avec les Finances et la direction de l'ingénierie

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- Plus de 8 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, dont plus de 2 ans en gestion d'ingénieur(e)s, une expérience en fintech, en paiements ou en systèmes financiers étant un atout

- De l'expérience dans la conception et l'exploitation de systèmes transactionnels à haut volume où l'exactitude, l'idempotence et l'auditabilité sont essentielles

- Une connaissance pratique des fondements de la comptabilité, dont la comptabilité en partie double, les grands livres et grands livres auxiliaires, le rapprochement et le processus de clôture financière, ainsi que la capacité de les appliquer à la conception de systèmes

- Une approche systémique de l'architecture, privilégiant des invariants clairs, des abstractions propres et l'automatisation plutôt que les correctifs ponctuels, ainsi que de l'expérience dans la conduite de refontes ou de migrations d'envergure de systèmes financiers en production

- Une communication claire tant avec les comptables qu'avec les ingénieur(e)s, y compris la capacité d'expliquer les compromis techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques

- Un sens de l'organisation et une autonomie marqués dans un environnement en forte croissance

- Être établi(e) dans le fuseau horaire de l'Est ou du Centre, avec un chevauchement quotidien avec les équipes Finances, Comptabilité et ingénierie avec lesquelles vous

This role is based within Go Fish Digital , Agital's engineering-forward performance marketing agency. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.
